entries.notes: Corrected a transcription slip: prior extraction's core_meaning and first variance read 'لَكُمَ' (root ل-ك-م) but the page and the entry's own root letters (ل ك ع) show 'لَكُعَ' — fixed to match. The cited verse's exact sense ('إذا مُسّ دبره لكعا') is uncertain — footnote (1) says the line is in Lisān al-ʿArab (خشش، لكم) attributed to al-Aṣbaʿ al-ʿAdwānī but not part of his poem in that meter per al-Mufaḍḍaliyyāt; full line given as 'إما ترى نبله نخضرم خش... إذا مس دبره لكما', itself partly obscure.
